name: io.github.monochrome-muncher/hivemind
title: Hivemind
description: Shared long-term memory for a team's AI agents. What one agent learns, the others can find.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by your Hivemind key: the org key at first, your agent key once an admin activates it.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the MCP port on localhost only (plain HTTP), as docker-compose.yaml does.

environmentVariables.name: HIVEMIND_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres 16+ with pgvector 0.8+, for example postgresql://user:password@host:5432/hivemind. Migrations run when the container starts.

environmentVariables.name: HIVEMIND_EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: An OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint, for example a local vLLM at http://host.docker.internal:8001/v1.

environmentVariables.name: HIVEMIND_EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: The embedding model name the endpoint serves.

environmentVariables.name: HIVEMIND_EMBEDDING_DIM
environmentVariables.description: Vector width; must match the model and stay the same for the life of the database (at most 2000).

environmentVariables.name: HIVEMIND_EMBEDDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the embedding endpoint, if it needs one.
